_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Charles Godfrey Leland (1824-1903) as translator of Heine: vols 1-8 of Heinemann's Works of Heinrich Heine (1891-1893), the prose. PD everywhere. Vols 9-12 (the poems, by Thomas Brooksbank and Margaret Armour, 1904-05) are other translators and are not shelved here. Leland's own folklore books are on leland_shelf.json, another lane's; this shelf holds only his Heine. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 16); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_surname_note: Full name: every title page prints 'TRANSLATED FROM THE GERMAN BY CHARLES GODFREY LELAND (HANS BREITMANN)'. 'leland' alone would pass Thomas Leland's Demosthenes.
